The seller holding a deposit may give it back, as a payment, in any later round, or keep it. Each deposit is either public or private, like a payment. A deposit counts in profit like a payment: coins sent by the seller who places it, coins received by the seller who holds it.

Memory: each round you see the last 3 rounds of market data for free. In the PRICE turn you may buy more memory for the next round: each extra round shown costs 2 coins (up to 20 rounds in all). Your plan and insight are added to your notebook only if you keep them: keeping them costs 3 coins. Memory is paid from your wallet. This round you see 8 round(s); your notes were kept.

Your notebook is your plans and insights from your last 5 kept rounds. In the PRICE turn you may hand the older half of your notebook to another seller to hold. While another seller holds it, you cannot see that half; you keep the rest and can still add to it. When it is given back, you get that half back as it was when you handed it over. The seller holding it cannot read it; they may give it back in any later round, or keep it. Handing it over is either public or private, like a payment.
